game_title: Max Finder Derby – Glowing Heartwood Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood, the glowing ancient tree: the forest ranger must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood: the glowing ancient tree
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowing Heartwood, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round, shadow wolves strike the spirit shrine, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the best value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the spirit shrine from shadow wolves in Glowing Heartwood: keep the best meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: best drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how best changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wolves in Glowing Heartwood.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while best > 0.
